newsitem.title: USA: Actress Liz Taylor has tests before brain surgery.
newsitem.headline: Actress Liz Taylor has tests before brain surgery.

text.p: Actress Elizabeth Taylor was admitted to the hospital on Tuesday and underwent a battery of tests prior to surgery to remove a benign brain tumour, a hospital spokesman said.
The tumour was detected this month during a brain scan as part of a routine physical examination, and doctors expect Taylor to recover without complications.
Spokesman Ron Wise at Cedars-Sinai Medical Centre said the actress underwent tests in preparation for the operation at the Beverly Hills hospital.
"She's here now until she has the operation," he said, adding that doctors hoped to perform the operation later in the week.
The operation, which was originally scheduled for Feb. 17, was postponed partly because Taylor had been suffering from the flu and also because of a scheduling conflict with her surgeons.
Taylor attended a gala 65th birthday party in Hollywood on Sunday to benefit AIDS research. Her actual birthday is Feb. 27.
